input: Set up a fish tank in the kids' room

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Fish Tank in the Kids' Room
gold.taskDescription: Set up a fully functional fish tank in the children's bedroom, from choosing equipment to having live fish in the tank.

questions.title: What size tank are you thinking of getting?
questions.description: Understanding the tank size helps plan for space, budget, and equipment requirements.

questions.title: Do you already own a tank or need to buy one?
questions.description: Knowing whether equipment needs to be purchased affects the first steps of the plan.

questions.title: What type of fish do the kids want to keep?
questions.description: Fish species determine water type, tank mates, feeding, and care complexity.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this setup?
questions.description: Budget shapes decisions on tank size, filtration, décor, and fish selection.

questions.title: How old are the kids who will help care for it?
questions.description: The children's ages influence how complex or simple the setup and maintenance routine should be.

questions.title: Is there a specific spot in the room already in mind?
questions.description: The intended location affects furniture arrangement, access to power outlets, and floor load considerations.

questions.title: When do you want the tank ready with fish in it?
questions.description: A target date helps structure the timeline, including the nitrogen cycling period before adding fish.
